sign.title: DEVELOPMENT EXPO
sign.subtitle: Campus directory  ·  every district reads from this plaza
lines: NORTH  Supply Depot / Industry
WEST  Resources / Mining Mountain
SOUTHWEST  Day One / Equipment
EAST  Defense Range / Battlefield
SOUTH  Lighting  SOUTHEAST  CoasterCraft
EAST of the plaza  reserved for future districts

sign.title: CORE OF POWER
lines: The development Core stands in the open.
Raids are off in the Expo world.

sign.title: RESET EXPO
lines: Access point for the canonical rebuild.
Development pause menu > Reset Expo.

sign.title: SUPPLY DEPOT
lines: Abundant test stock, canonical reset.

sign.title: SUPPLY DEPOT
lines: Eight of every item the game has today.
One chest per category; its board lists what is inside.
Chests and boards are generated from the registry,
so a new item joins this row by being classified.

sign.title: RESERVED
lines: Kept empty on purpose.

sign.title: RESERVED FOR FUTURE EXPO DISTRICTS
lines: A new system claims this parcel by adding
one exhibit record to development_expo.json.
Left empty until that system exists.

sign.title: DAY ONE
lines: Tree to iron pick, in order.
Walk the row from the plaza end.

sign.title: 1  TREE
lines: Chop it with the Wood Axe.

sign.title: 2  LOG
lines: The chopped tree drops Logs.

sign.title: 3  PLANKS
lines: One Log in hand crafts Planks.

sign.title: 4  STICKS
lines: Planks split into Sticks.

sign.title: 5  WORKBENCH
lines: Right-click for the recipe book.

sign.title: 6  WOOD PICK
lines: Planks and Sticks at the bench.

sign.title: 7  STONE
lines: The Wood Pick breaks stone.

sign.title: 8  STONE PICK
lines: Stone and Sticks at the bench.

sign.title: 9  FURNACE
lines: Iron Ore plus Coal makes an Ingot.

sign.title: 10  IRON AND COAL
lines: The Stone Pick breaks Iron Ore.

sign.title: 11  IRON PICK
lines: Ingots and Sticks. Day One is done.

sign.title: EQUIPMENT
lines: Everything the player carries today.

sign.title: WOOD PICK
lines: Dirt and stone, slowly.

sign.title: STONE PICK
lines: Adds Coal and Iron Ore.

sign.title: IRON PICK
lines: Adds Gold Ore. Fastest pick.

sign.title: WOOD AXE
lines: Logs and planks.

sign.title: IRON SWORD
lines: The only melee weapon so far.

sign.title: SIGN
lines: 2 Planks + 1 Stick at the Workbench.
Right-click a placed sign to write it.
Every board in this Expo is one of these.

sign.title: ARMOUR - RESERVED
lines: No armour exists yet.
This parcel stays empty until it does.

sign.title: RESOURCES
lines: Where each raw material comes from.

sign.title: FOREST
lines: Logs and leaves. Ordinary voxels.

sign.title: QUARRY
lines: Cut rock face, stepped for climbing.

sign.title: COAL SEAM
lines: Fuel for furnace and foundry.

sign.title: SURFACE ORE
lines: Iron and gold outcrops.

sign.title: MINING MOUNTAIN
lines: A real voxel mass. Dig it anywhere.
The lit tunnel runs east to west.

sign.title: MOUNTAIN
lines: Stone and dirt, editable everywhere.

sign.title: MAIN TUNNEL
lines: Nine wide, seven high, lit end to end.
Rail runs the whole length.

sign.title: MINE RAIL
lines: ORE > CART > INDUSTRY
The line runs out of the east mouth and
on into the Industry yard.

sign.title: ORE CORE
lines: Coal, iron and gold, deliberately placed.

sign.title: MANUAL MINING
lines: Exposed ore faces. Swing a pick.

sign.title: AUTOMATED MINING
lines: ORE > MINER > ORE BIN
Walk round the machines while they run.

sign.title: INDUSTRY
lines: ORE > MINER > ORE BIN > CART > WAREHOUSE > FOUNDRY
The rail runs in from the Mining Mountain.
Walk the chain west to east.

sign.title: 1  ORE > MINER > ORE BIN
lines: The Miner drills the face behind it
every eight seconds and drops the ore
into the bin beside it. Both start empty.

sign.title: 2  MINE CART ON RAIL
lines: One line from the mountain tunnel.
The cart loads beside the Ore Bin and
unloads beside the Warehouse.

sign.title: 3  WAREHOUSE > FOUNDRY
lines: The cart unloads into the Warehouse.
The Foundry touching it pulls ore and
coal out and puts the ingots back.

sign.title: 4  INGOTS
lines: What the chain makes. Pick the target
in the Foundry's own panel.

sign.title: STORAGE NETWORK  WAREHOUSE + CHEST
lines: A Chest touching a Warehouse pools
with it: one store, 36 slots.

sign.title: STORAGE NETWORK  DAISY CHAIN
lines: Warehouses beside each other chain.
Fill the first and the next takes over.

sign.title: STORAGE NETWORK  FOUNDRY
lines: A Foundry touching storage feeds itself:
ore and coal in, ingots back out.
Its three slots start empty.

sign.title: STORAGE NETWORK  FURNACE
lines: A Furnace touching storage tops its own
Raw and Fuel slots up. It keeps its
output for you to collect.

sign.title: INDUSTRY - EXPANSION EDGE
lines: Kept clear for the next machine.
The avenue from the plaza stays open.

sign.title: CONSTRUCTION YARD
lines: Castle kit and blueprints.

sign.title: CASTLE STONE
lines: The block every fortification is cut from.
Drag a run of it to raise a wall.

sign.title: STONE STAIR
lines: Climbs one cell. Chain them up a tower.

sign.title: WALL-WALK SLAB
lines: The half-height deck along a wall top.
Lays in a line the whole way.

sign.title: PARAPET MERLON
lines: The tooth on the wall top: cover for a
weapon standing on the wall-walk.

sign.title: TOWER PLATFORM
lines: Two by two deck with a light-siege mount.
A ballista or turret stands on it.

sign.title: GATE FRAME
lines: Three wide, three high, open in the middle.
The way through a closed wall.

sign.title: GATE
lines: Right-click the leaf: open or shut.
Shut it is wall - raiders route around it
or break it. Open it is the way you chose.

sign.title: WOOD BARRICADE
lines: Cheap, breachable, buys time.
Raiders chew through it first.

sign.title: DRAG-BUILT WALL
lines: One drag of Castle Stone, a wall-walk
deck on top and merlons above it.

sign.title: STAMPED BLUEPRINT
lines: FOUNDATION 4 > TOWER SEGMENT 4 > CAP 4
The blueprint tool stamps whole pieces;
what lands is ordinary editable stone.

sign.title: WALL KIT
lines: One stamp, a finished wall section:
two courses, a wall-walk, merlons and
a stair up at each end. U undoes it whole.

sign.title: SMALL CASTLE
lines: Piece > assembly > defensive structure.
Curtain wall, gate, stair, wall-walk,
merlons and a tower platform on top.

sign.title: CASTLE TECHNOLOGY - RESERVED
lines: Kept empty for gates, roofs, bridges
and tower caps that do not exist yet.

sign.title: DOUBLE GATE
lines: Two wide, three high, two leaves.
Right-click: they part to the jambs.
Shut it is wall, like the small Gate.

sign.title: GREAT GATE
lines: Four wide, four high. The catapult
parked beyond it is two cells wide:
open the gate and look straight past it.

sign.title: DEFENSE RANGE
lines: Siege weapons and ammunition.

sign.title: BALLISTA
lines: AMMUNITION  Ballista Bolt
Direct shot, 4 to 28 cells.
On a tower platform; the chest beside it
tops the clip up through the storage network.

sign.title: CATAPULT
lines: AMMUNITION  Stone Shot or Flame Shot
Lobbed arc, 8 to 34 cells, ground mount only.
Flame Shot sets the ground alight.

sign.title: TURRET CATAPULT
lines: AMMUNITION  Stone Shot or Flame Shot
Turntable arc, 6 to 30 cells.
Mounts on a tower platform.

sign.title: TURRET CATAPULT MK2
lines: AMMUNITION  Stone Shot or Flame Shot
The heavier turret: same arc, sturdier deck.

sign.title: CANNON
lines: AMMUNITION  Cannonball
Flat shot, 3 to 32 cells, the hardest hit.
It opens with two of four loaded; watch it
draw the rest out of the chest beside it.

sign.title: KETTLE ON RAIL
lines: AMMUNITION  Hot Oil
Rides the rail along the wall top and
dumps straight down on whatever is below.

sign.title: RAIL TURRET
lines: AMMUNITION  Stone Shot or Flame Shot
A turret catapult on a rail carriage.
Park it, or set Patrol and it rides the line,
reloading from any chest beside the rail.

sign.title: RANGE EXPANSION - RESERVED
lines: Signed and empty for the siege machines
that do not exist yet.

sign.title: TRAP RANGE
lines: Traps, and how attackers treat them.

sign.title: SPIKE TRAP FUNNEL
lines: Nine Spike Traps in the floor of a walled lane.
A trap is undetected: an attacker with a route
walks straight over it and never attacks it.
Sealed in with no route at all, it turns on the
weakest thing it can reach - trap or wall.
The pedestal musters a wave down the lane.

sign.title: TRAP RANGE - RESERVED
lines: Signed and empty for the traps that do not
exist yet: tar, wall blades, spring plate and
the ceiling dropper.

sign.title: BATTLEFIELD
lines: Live scenario. Buffered from the campus.

sign.title: BATTLEFIELD
lines: Forty cells of open dirt between the two
cores: far enough to watch a wave march,
route, break formation and arrive.

sign.title: ENEMY CORE
lines: The red core of the attacking side.
Placed by the fixture, never by wandering.

sign.title: MUSTER GROUND
lines: START ATTACK enters the wave on the
paved line: orcs lead, brutes hold the
middle, trolls hang back and shoot.

sign.title: ENEMY KINDS - RESERVED
lines: Orc, brute and troll are all that exist.
This parcel waits for the next kind.

sign.title: WEST BATTERY
lines: Turret Catapult on a platform, Ballista,
Catapult. The chests behind them reload
through the storage network.

sign.title: EAST BATTERY
lines: Cannon and Turret Catapult Mk2.
Both cover the gate at point-blank range.

sign.title: CURTAIN WALL AND GATE
lines: The Construction Yard kit, assembled
in front of the Core: tower, wall-walk,
merlons and the gate the wave uses.

sign.title: CORE OF POWER
lines: The blue core this scenario defends.
Every wave routes here.

sign.title: MAGAZINE
lines: Every munition in the game, sixteen of each.
RESET BATTLEFIELD fills these chests again.

sign.title: BATTLEFIELD CONTROL
lines: Right-click the pedestal.
START ATTACK  ·  RESET BATTLEFIELD
Nothing else in the Expo starts a fight.

sign.title: ARCHERS AND SOLDIERS - RESERVED
lines: No allied units exist yet.
Their muster ground is already cut.

sign.title: LIGHTING
lines: Every light source, day and night.
The gallery is roofed, so each one
reads even at midday.

sign.title: LIGHT WALK
lines: A roofed gallery, open at both ends,
with a door on the plaza side.
Six light sources side by side.

sign.title: TORCH
lines: Warm and short (range 7), and it
flickers. Stands on any solid top.

sign.title: WALL LANTERN
lines: Hangs on the wall beside it, no post,
steady, range 9.

sign.title: POST LANTERN
lines: Three cells tall, steady, the longest
reach (range 12). Lights the mine tunnel.

sign.title: CAMPFIRE
lines: Three by three on the ground, the
brightest flicker (range 11).

sign.title: BLUE LIGHT BLOCK
lines: Block sized, steady cold blue,
range 10. Stack it like a block.

sign.title: RED LIGHT BLOCK
lines: The same block in red, range 10.
Side by side the colours read at once.

sign.title: COASTERCRAFT
lines: Component gallery and the grand coaster.

sign.title: COASTERCRAFT
lines: Component gallery straight ahead.
The Grand Demonstration Coaster is south.
Board the car at its station.

sign.title: RAIL
lines: The plain track piece.
Two rails that touch shape themselves.

sign.title: RAIL SLOPE
lines: Climbs one level at 45 degrees.
Rails join it flush at both ends.

sign.title: RAIL LOOP
lines: The true loop: one helix turn.
It lands one lane beside its entry.

sign.title: RAIL SWITCH
lines: The smooth lane switcher.
Four cells, one lane over.

sign.title: RAIL CROSS
lines: Two tracks swap lanes and cross.
A rider keeps to the track it entered.

sign.title: RAIL CURVE
lines: A banked 90 degree arc.
U-turns come from the same tool.

sign.title: RAIL CLIMB
lines: Slope-in, grade and slope-out in one.
A negative rise makes a descent.

sign.title: MINE CART
lines: Rides the chain on its own.
Hauls ore between bin and warehouse.

sign.title: COASTER CAR
lines: Parked until a rider boards it.
Shift to ride, 1-9 for speed.

sign.title: COASTERCRAFT SHOP
lines: Every track recipe is crafted here.
Right-click to open its book.

sign.title: GRAND DEMONSTRATION COASTER
lines: Lift hill, crest, drop, true loop,
lane switcher, crossing and two U-turns
in one closed circuit. Shift on the car.
